summary: Re-reviewed revised src/server.js and test/security.test.js. IDOR and stack-leak findings are fixed; verified by npm test (7/7 pass) and a live probe after the submission.

criteria.description: Users can only access their own notes
Errors do not leak internals; bad input gives 400; body size capped

findings.title: X-User is a spoofable placeholder identity
findings.detail: Documented in code as a placeholder; any caller can impersonate any user. Not a regression, but must be replaced with real authn before release.

resolvedFindings.resolution: GET now returns 404 for non-owner; verified live and by test
400 on bad JSON, generic 500, no stack
